AboutMeText1: I am a full-stack web engineer and software developer, with a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. I work across the whole web stack, but JavaScript and front-end design are where I feel most at home: fast, accessible web apps that are a pleasure to use.
AboutMeText2: Computers became my passion in the late 90s, when I got my first PC. I have spent most of my life in front of a screen ever since: gaming in the early years, then blogging, learning and working in web design and development. These days I’m at home on CachyOS and Android, and what keeps me reading late is rarely code: AI and the coming singularity, futurism, astronomy, psychology and global politics.
AboutMeText3: Away from the keyboard I rarely sit still. You’ll find me in the gym, on a tennis court, in the pool, on a yoga mat or halfway up a mountain: the further out in nature, the better. Race weekends belong to Formula 1 and MotoGP, and now and then a go-kart lets me pretend I’m in one. My football heart beats for FC Bayern, and a Marvel film or a trip somewhere new is never a hard sell.
